style: An EMPTY ROOM: a background plate for a game screen, with no interface in it at all - no panels, no plaques, no cards, no buttons, no bars, no icons, no clock, no words, no letters, no numbers anywhere. Photoreal, dark and cinematic, with atmosphere (haze, floor light, depth). No watermark, no caption.

moments.title: Auction room plate
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its composition, camera, lighting, colours and materials exactly. Change only this: remove the two framed plaques from the walls, the bar across the top, the round icon in the corner and the two buttons at the bottom, and paint the wood panelling, carpet and floor that were behind them. Everything else stays: the chandelier, the spotlight beam, the two leather club chairs, the brass posts and the red velvet rope, the haze, the red carpet. An empty auction room with no text anywhere.

moments.title: Versus gym plate
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its composition, camera, lighting, colours and materials exactly. Change only this: remove the two glowing roster panels left and right, the title and clock at the top and the bar at the bottom, and paint the gym that was behind them - the dark walls, the lockers with hooks, the benches, the hardwood floor with its reflections. Everything else stays: the court in perspective, the hoop, the blue neon on the left and the red neon on the right, the haze. An empty gym with no text anywhere.

moments.title: War room plate
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its camera, lighting, colours and materials exactly. Change only this: empty the room of everything that stands in it, so it is the scouting war room alone late at night - the single hanging lamp over the centre, the haze in its light, the dark plaster-and-wood walls, deep shadow at the edges, and the long oak table top running across the bottom third of the frame, bare. The chalkboard, the slot machine, the light table, every card, dossier, plate and word are gone. An empty room with no text anywhere.

moments.title: Home arena plate
moments.prompt: Repaint the reference image keeping its camera, lighting, colours and materials exactly. Change only this: empty the arena of every piece of interface, so it is the arena interior alone at night - the rafter spotlights, one warm beam falling on the centre of the court, haze in the light, dark empty stands rising on every side, the polished hardwood floor filling the lower half of the frame with the hoop at the far end and the centre circle in the foreground carrying an orange basketball mark. The banners, the panel, the exit signs, every word, number and logo are gone. An empty arena with no text anywhere.

moments.title: Home stage: the arena with its six banners
moments.prompt: The FIRST image is the scene: keep it exactly - the empty arena, the rafter lights, the one beam on centre court, the haze, the stands, the floor with its orange ball mark. Change only this: SIX banners now hang from the rafters in a row over the left half of the picture, in the style of the banners in the SECOND image - tall dark navy pennants with a thin orange edge and a pointed bottom, each with one big bold white numeral and a short white label under it. Left to right: 2 SALARY CAP, 3 DEATH MATCH, 1 CAMPAIGN, 4 CUSTOM, 5 VS FRIEND, 6 1V1 BID, evenly spaced, all six hanging at the same height with their tops just under the rafters, all six lit the same (none singled out), the beam passing between them to the floor. The right half of the picture stays as it is in the first image: arena only, nothing drawn on it. No panel, no text anywhere except the six banners.
